hardening_r1_fix.issue: grantFacetFields returned undefined (whole-resource) for present-but-malformed resourceFacet ({fields:123}, {fields:'bad'}, etc.), violating fail-closed principle in authority core.
hardening_r1_fix.fix_summary: grantFacetFields now returns undefined ONLY for strictly-absent facet (undefined/null); present-but-malformed returns [] fail-closed. Two-case distinction ensures no field widening on malformed input.

hardening_r2_r3.r2_change: isLatticeScope now discriminates on scope.kind !== 'freeform' instead of enumerating all kinds — structurally tied to T-0018 GrantScope union; no silent divergence if T-0018 adds a fifth lattice kind.
hardening_r2_r3.r3_change: TODO(T-0053) comment added to resolveFor marking the intentional FR-8 AuditObligation static-now gap (durable append deferred to T-0053).

ac_1.text: resolveHandle(handle, subject) with NO covering grant returns {denied:true, reason:'no_grant'}

ac_2.text: Handle tenantId != subject.tenantId returns cross_tenant BEFORE any grant/record read

ac_3.text: Grants re-queried per call: covering at t0 {denied:false}, empty at t1 {denied:true,'no_grant'}

ac_5.text: Human==agent equivalence: same inputs → deep-equal outputs; one projectFields function both invoke

ac_6.text: Visible field set = union of covering grants' facet fields intersected with handle Facet; masked fields absent (not null)

ac_7.text: Read grant does not satisfy update request; operation mismatch => {denied:true,'no_grant'}

ac_8.text: Handle ref not isNarrowerOrEqual grant scope => {denied:true,'no_grant'}; inside subtree => resolved

ac_9.text: RecordSource reports ref absent => {denied:true, reason:'not_found'}; no fabricated fields

ac_10.text: Single chokepoint: resolveHandle stays the only handle->fields export; ci/checks/single-resolver.sh green

ac_11.text: No second authority subsystem: decision and field set from grant rows only (T-0018); no parallel ACL

ac_12.text: Pure: two invocations with deeply-equal inputs return deeply-equal outputs; no IO outside injected ports

ac_13.text: Type-checks as const grantResolver: HandleResolver; can replace denyAllResolver at seam with no signature change

ac_14.text: DB enforcement (activates later): 'no direct DAO path' enforced by Postgres role-permissions + RLS

ac_15.text: Deploy/runtime enforcement (activates later): engine variables carry only handles; engine mutates only via gateway
